notes.content:

Thank you for always playing "Pretty Girls" series!
We are pleased to inform you that we have released a great bundle pack.

This bundle pack contains the Pretty Girls Escape series.
Let's enjoy the puzzle games as much as you want with cute beautiful girls!

◆Pretty Girls Escape Bundle
Titles included in the bundle:

Pretty Girls Escape
Pretty Girls Escape PLUS

You can get a 20% bundle discount on this bundle pack.
For details, please check here.

We look forward to working with you in the future.
